scope: Four fixed-geometry solves on the accepted LP2-A1 S8 geometries with the LP2-A2 paired-bank mesh family; each compared with its archived LP2-A1 S8 solution. No trajectory, no state acceptance, no S9 solve.
goRequirement: An explicit investigator decision GO_LP2A2_EQ in the PR thread. The GO file (g2_lp2a2_eq_go_validate) must give decision GO_LP2A2_EQ, the token, solveLimit 4, solves exactly EQ-H, EQ-stiff13, EQ-soft2, EQ-soft1 in this order, the campaignId, a decision URL of the form https://github.com/mfs9697/NewMetacomp/pull/<n>#issuecomment-<n> or #pullrequestreview-<n>, the full 40-hex approved (reviewed) head, and the contract-evidence file with its SHA-256. The activation commit must add only the GO file directly on the approved head. Physical calls require the normal preflight. No GO exists in this policy commit.

pins.lp2a2SourceDefinition: g2_lp1_digest over sorted lines "<name> <sha256>" of matlab/g2/lp2a2/*.m

meshFamily.mesher: g2_lp2a2_mesh (seed-spacing ladder over g2_lp2a2_join = g2_kinked_regular_block + g2_lp2a2_exterior_mesh)
meshFamily.rungRule: next rung only when the global join quality gates fail; the equivalence campaign requires rung 1 (0.45 mm) on all four S8 geometries; a continuation state meshed at a higher rung differs from rung 1 only in the bank seed spacing and is NOT covered by this campaign
meshFamily.unchanged: p010 core 3.0 mm, collar 3.3 mm, 64 sectors, q domains, COD/EDI, phase mapping, 15-mm guide, 4-mm increment, all LP1/LP2 acceptance criteria
meshFamily.difference: explicit paired bank seeds: m_k = ceil(L_k/0.45) pieces per centre-line segment (starter 57 instead of the old 51), guide-circle crossings as forced paired seeds; the exterior PDE mesh is regenerated

toleranceJustification.reference_A1: A1 near-tip refinement m=0->9 at S4: deltaG ~1.1e-4 relative, deltaTheta_MTS 1.2-1.8e-4 deg, |deltaF_G| <= 5.1e-6, EDI change <= 6e-5, COD-EDI 8.8e-3 -> 2.5e-3 (A1 report).
toleranceJustification.reference_LP2A1: LP2-A1 S8: COD-EDI 0.876-0.880 %, path spread 1.64e-6, |J/G-1| <= 3.1e-5, K_II/K_I 0.0079-0.0146; per-step F_G change >= 0.34 percentage points; smallest |F_G| 1.488 % (soft2); S9 relative headings +0.406, -0.060, -0.506 deg; stiff13 local MTS difference +0.383 deg.
toleranceJustification.expected_effect: The near-tip core and collar are identical; only the bank discretization outside the collar and the exterior PDE mesh change. The change is therefore expected to be of the order of far-field discretization effects, at or below the A1 near-tip sensitivity.
toleranceJustification.KI_G_J: G/J within 1e-3 (K_I within 5e-4 K_eq): about 10x the A1 near-tip sensitivity, yet at least 15x below the smallest architecture contrast (1.49 %) and 3x below one step of F_G change.
toleranceJustification.KII_MTS: MTS ~ -2 K_II/K_I rad for small mixity; K_II within 5e-5 K_eq gives |dTheta| <= 0.0057 deg: 30x the A1 refinement change, 10 % of the smallest S9 relative heading (soft1 -0.060 deg) and 1.5 % of the stiff13 MTS contrast.
toleranceJustification.S9predictor: A 4-mm step with |dTheta| <= 0.006 deg moves the predicted tip by <= 4.2e-4 mm; the tolerance is 5e-4 mm.
toleranceJustification.COD_EDI: The inherited 3 % gate must hold; the change of the blind COD-EDI difference must stay within 1e-3 (A1 refinement changed it by 6e-3 with a refined near-tip mesh; here the near-tip mesh is identical).
toleranceJustification.spread_quadrature: Path spread and 4x4 quadrature differences must stay below max(1e-5, 5x the archived value).
toleranceJustification.opening: Near-tip jumps at identical node positions within 1e-3 of the near-tip maximum; whole-crack jump (archived linearly interpolated to the new stations) within 2e-3 of the maximum opening.
toleranceJustification.phase: Activation labels verified by the solver gates, same ring chord count, active ring area identical to 1e-9 relative (CAD circles, same chords).
toleranceJustification.contrast: F_G = G_X/G_H - 1 recomputed from the four new solutions must differ from the archived contrast by <= 2e-4 absolute (<= 1.4 % of the smallest contrast, <= 6 % of one step) with unchanged sign and order; theta_X - theta_H within 0.01 deg.

interpretation.EQUIVALENT: All criteria of all four solves and the contrast check pass: the LP2-A2 mesh family reproduces the accepted S8 results within the preregistered numerical tolerances. This is NUMERICAL EQUIVALENCE on four geometries, NOT a certified discretization-error bound for either family and not a convergence statement.
interpretation.NOT_EQUIVALENT: Any criterion fails: HOLD; the new family may not be used for continuation until the difference is explained in a separate review. No retry, no tolerance change after any solve.
